en.title: The consent letter checklist
en.note: Get it notarised: many borders expect it
en.focal: Print it, and keep a digital backup
en.alt: Checklist diagram of what a child travel consent letter must include: child's full name, date of birth, passport number, exact travel dates, destinations and the absent parent's contact details, with notes to get it notarised, the top rejection reasons, and to print it and keep a digital backup
en.caption: Six details, one notarisation, and a printed copy cover almost every border's expectations.
